# Stout Training Pittsburgh

> > Pittsburgh's premier Team Renzo Gracie affiliate offering Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, MMA, and Muay Thai training across four locations in the Greater Pittsburgh Area.

Stout Training operates gyms in Strip District, Zelienople, Monroeville, and Bridgeville, providing structured martial arts programs from beginner fundamentals to advanced competition training. Founded by Warren Stout, the gym emphasizes both gi and no-gi BJJ training alongside striking arts.

## Key Topics

- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ)
- Team Renzo Gracie
- Muay Thai
- Mixed Martial Arts (MMA)
